description: Seller: let buyers pay you in XRP or RLUSD (XRP Ledger, e.g. a Xaman wallet), straight into your own wallet. Public addresses only, never a seed. PazAIr takes its usual fee as a separate payment and never holds your money. Your first wallet counts at once; a new or changed address only after 48 hours (pending), so a stolen key cannot divert payments.
name: set_crypto_wallet
